comment: How the packages of daasiot-android are made (platforms/scripts/build_dist.py). Every package holds one folder with its own name, MANIFEST.json and SHA256SUMS, with <package>.<format>.sha256 next to it. Intermediate files in dist/stages/. The specialized drivers go out compiled only (driver_sources never in a package).

aar.name: {product}-{version}-aar
aar.description: the AAR of android_daas (Java API it.sebyone.daas, libandroid_daas_jni.so of every ABI with libdaas and the BLE driver on blew), the example, the docs

drivers-sdk.name: {product}-{version}-drivers-sdk-{linkage}
drivers-sdk.description: the android-drivers-sdk: the specialized drivers compiled (drivers_kit of every ABI, no driver source), the template and the CMake files of a new driver
